audit_metadata.title: Independent Pre-Evaluation Audit of SGG Dataset Preparation
audit_metadata.verdict_summary: Dataset files, images, ground-truth annotations, and normalized evaluation views are 100% verified, corruption-free, and reproduce all reported metrics exactly. Benchmarking may proceed subject to 4 essential methodological disclosures: (1) IndoorVG test images overlap 100% with VG150 training set; (2) Cross-dataset evaluation requires PredCls mode due to disjoint object vocabularies; (3) Model prediction projection layers are required; (4) Zero-relation image handling in Recall@K must be standardized.

Cross-dataset image leakage: IndoorVG_200 images in VG150 TRAIN split
checks.evidence: All 200 images (100%) of IndoorVG_200 are present in the official VG150 training split (68,538 images). Models pretrained on VG150 have seen all IndoorVG_200 test images.

checks.description: ID namespace collision between VG150 and PSG (7 identical integer IDs)
checks.evidence: 7 image IDs (2315368, 2315402, 2315458, 2315515, 2315487, 2315399, 2315372) appear in both VG150_200 and PSG_200. Verified distinct images (different pixel hashes, dimensions, scene content). ID collision is due to independent dataset namespaces.

checks.description: Ascending numerical/lexicographical sort on first 200 IDs selection bias
checks.evidence: Selecting first 200 sorted IDs creates contiguous temporal/batch clustering in VG150 (2315353-2316499) and shard 0 concentration in IndoorVG. Open Images hex sort behaves as quasi-random uniform hash.

checks.description: Cross-dataset object vocabulary compatibility (VG150: 150, PSG: 133, IndoorVG: 84, OpenImages: 75)
checks.evidence: Object vocabularies are completely disjoint across the four datasets. Cross-dataset evaluation is methodologically valid in PredCls mode (given GT boxes & labels) or native dataset evaluation, but invalid for direct cross-dataset SGDet without an object ontology.

checks.description: Model prediction projection layer for normalized evaluation ontology
checks.evidence: Models output native dataset predicate logits (e.g., 50 classes for VG150, 56 for PSG). Evaluation pipeline requires a logit projection/mapping layer to map predictions onto normalized ontology classes (1..6, 1..8, 1..20).

checks.description: Handling of images with 0 GT relationships in filtered views
checks.evidence: Filtered views have images with 0 GT relationships (OpenImages strict: 158/200; VG150 strict: 59/200). Pipeline must standardize whether images with 0 relations are excluded (filter_empty_rels=True) or assigned Recall=0.0.

checks.description: Handling of duplicate GT triplets in Recall@K evaluation
checks.evidence: Ground truth contains duplicate triplets (IndoorVG: 335, VG150: 148, PSG: 43). Evaluation code must specify set-based union matching vs multi-graph matching.
